name: Cross-build ledger-jni for Android
command: cd /home/cllin/pocket-ledger && export PATH="$HOME/.cargo/bin:$PATH" ANDROID_NDK_HOME="$HOME/android-sdk/ndk/27.2.12479018" ANDROID_NDK_ROOT="$HOME/android-sdk/ndk/27.2.12479018" && mkdir -p android/app/src/main/jniLibs && cargo ndk -t arm64-v8a -t x86_64 -o android/app/src/main/jniLibs build -p ledger-jni --release 2>&1 | tail -25 && find android/app/src/main/jniLibs -name "*.so" -exec ls -la {} \;
